soi.text: Liliana's manor is a storm-lashed house where Jace arrives, picks the gate lock with telekinesis after a werewolf kills his horse, and passes through a yard of silent zombies to reach her.
There Liliana refuses his freely given aid, and when he says he is looking for Sorin Markov, she warns him not to go and sets her zombie servants on him until he is held helpless against the wall.

Later, as she broods in the manor, Jace invades her mind and accuses her of helping the angels at the Drownyard, and their fight leaves her racked by the Chain Veil's backlash until she tells him she does not want to hurt him.
Jace leaves for Thraben, expecting to die there, and Liliana follows her servant Gared up the tower stairs with the Chain Veil.
